content.short: Cookie3 is a leading Marketing Intelligence platform that uses AI and on-chain analytics to help Web3 projects understand and grow their communities.
content.description: Cookie3 is building the first MarketingFi ecosystem by providing sophisticated analytics and AI-driven insights for Web3 brands and creators. By analyzing on-chain and off-chain data, Cookie3 allows projects to identify high-value users, optimize their marketing spend, and reward community members fairly. Its integration with the Mantle Network provides ecosystem projects with the data transparency needed to scale effectively and build sustainable user bases through verifiable analytics.
content.meta: Cookie3 provides AI-powered marketing intelligence and on-chain analytics for the Mantle ecosystem. Discover Cookie3 on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
